ERC20._balances: core token balance mapping, mutated by _transfer/_burn/_approve
ERC20._allowances: nested allowance mapping written by _approve
ERC20._totalSupply: total minted supply, increased in DeployPPC
ERC20._creator: privileged creator address gating special transfer/tax paths
Mapping of addresses exempt from frontrunner protection (whitelist)
Mapping of village-flagged addresses toggled inside _approve
CapitalContract threshold used by _frontrunnerProtection, set in DeployPPC
CapitalTax = _totalSupply/20, assigned to CapitalContract for creator transfers
PumpArmy max transfer threshold enforced in _frontrunnerProtection
uint16 pseudo-random value produced by randomly() via block.timestamp
Array of recipients appended in _transfer and iterated in _CapitalTaxGain
Flag enabling _CapitalTaxGain redistribution loop
Flag enabling balance division inside _approve
Flag controlling creator whitelist/tax branch in _transfer
Flag controlling whether _approve rewrites PumpContract/VillageContract

Internal guard restricting non-whitelisted senders to amounts below CapitalContract
Internal loop that divides balances of array members by randomly() output
Internal _approve: writes allowances, mutates whitelist flags and divides owner balance
External approve(spender, amount) entrypoint forwarding to _approve
External transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) entrypoint with allowance decrement
Internal _burn: subtracts from _balances and credits address(0)

onlyOwner renounceOwnership which zeroes _owner irreversibly
owner() view returning _owner used by the onlyOwner modifier
msg.sender via _msgSender(): caller-controlled address used for ownership and transfers
block.timestamp used with block.difficulty as miner-influenced entropy source
_balances[owner] / uint256(randomly()) inside _approve: division by attacker/mined value with zero risk
_balances[capitalArray[i]] / uint256(randomly()) inside _CapitalTaxGain loop
_balances[account] -= amount in _burn: unchecked-style balance decrement
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty)) % 16372 used as pseudo-randomness

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured in the Ownable constructor and assigned to _owner, granting privileged control
msg.sender flows as the sender argument into _transfer via transfer()/_approve()
block.timestamp is consumed by randomly(), making the generated value timestamp dependent
block.timestamp feeds the keccak-based modulo hash used as randomness inside randomly()
randomly() writes its result into the LaunchTheToken state variable
randomly() return value is used as the divisor of the balance division in _approve, enabling division-by-zero
randomly() return value is used as the divisor of the balance division in _CapitalTaxGain
_burn performs _balances[account] -= amount, a balance decrement vulnerable to arithmetic abuse
_approve executes the randomized balance division on the owner balance
_CapitalTaxGain executes the randomized balance division over capitalArray members
transfer() delegates all balance state changes to _transfer
approve() delegates allowance writes to _approve
transferFrom() calls _transfer before checking the allowance
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the allowance
increaseAllowance() calls _approve to raise the allowance
decreaseAllowance() calls _approve to lower the allowance
_transfer invokes _frontrunnerProtection before mutating balances
_transfer invokes _CapitalTaxGain which can divide many balances by randomness
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient
_transfer appends the recipient to capitalArray, growing unbounded iteration cost
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances
_approve conditionally rewrites PumpContract[spender] whitelist state
_approve reads ApproveCapital to decide whether to divide the owner balance
_CapitalTaxGain gated on sender being _creator for the redistribution loop
DeployPPC increases _totalSupply by the mint amount
DeployPPC credits _balances[account] with the minted amount
DeployPPC derives PumpArmy from CapitalTax*temp2, setting the transfer cap
renounceOwnership sets _owner = address(0), permanently disabling owner-restricted paths
onlyOwner compares _owner against msg.sender-derived _msgSender()
